notes.title: THE GAME BECOME FREE
notes.notes:
Hello, after 5 years the game become free.

THX all.

notes.title: Darwin's Test Online is now live!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33794342/9c1d796c573ede9c7c03fc825752adf8a7a3d592.jpg[/img]

[b]After many months, of playtests, and a bit late ^^, we are proud to announce:[/b]

[h1]Darwin's Test Online[/h1] [b][i](Free Update)[/i][/b]
[b]
In this new game mode you can:[/b]
[list]
[*]Play a new story in online co-op!
[*]Solve new tests designed for multiplayer.
[*]Download and play at levels created by the community.
[*]Create your own stories thanks to the Level Editor!
[*]Play online with your friends and the community.
[/list]

It was long with probably some bugs, but we hope you will like this update and finally we are ready to work on the new game of Wolfalone Studio.

[b]Thank you for the support.[/b]

[i]Julien Garcia
Wolfalone Studio[/i]

notes.title: Patch note : 01/11/19
notes.notes:
[b][u]Happy new year 2019 ![/u][/b]

Following the different Darwin's Test feedback, we have corrected the following points:
[list]
[*]Fixing a display bug in advanced options when changing languages.
[*]Fixing a display bug of the size of the gray band under the subtitles that was not responsive.
[*]Fixing a Zero-G motion bug when we touched the ground that was stopping the character.
[*]Resizing of the doors in Zero-G levels, to leave more place for the character so as not to die.
[*]Fixing the random replacement of the camera when Zero-G outing.
[*]Correction of the recording and display of the ranking timer of the levels 15,16,17,18 and 19. (The times carried out were not recorded).
[*]Upgrade of the Level 10 to make it a bit easier.
[*]Upgrade of the Level 8 to make it a bit easier.
[*]Added several steam achievements.
[*]Update of the lights in some levels.
[*]Correction of the English translation.
[*]Various corrections.
[*]Change of the 3D model of the switch.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33794342/a4c077f0b5bb8a769ae9053213019403d2869b45.png[/img]

[b]Thank you for the support.[/b]

[i]Julien Garcia
Wolfalone Studio[/i]
